items.title: 68154_Gus Johnson oral history interview
items.q: We used to walk in the studio, and if we see one another first -- somebody first, -- he'd holler out, "Who's playing drums?"

ctx.x: You surely don't. Because that guy, very extrovert and very happy-seeming guy, huh?

That's right. You take George Du- vivier, now. He's another one of my worst enemies. We used to walk in the studio, and if we see one another first -- somebody first, -- he'd holler out, "Who's playing drums?" And somebody would say, "Gus Johnson." "Gus Johnson? Give me my bass, let me get the hell out of here."
